## lab memory sync

```text
Upload the lab's changed Markdown notes to LocalRecall (the `memory` tool).
--install puts the hourly line (at :41) in your crontab, replacing an older one (run it yourself).
--dry-run shows what it would do.
Good result ends with "sync: N uploaded, M removed, K unchanged".
```

Usage:

```
lab memory sync [flags]
```

Options:

```
      --dry-run   show, change nothing
      --install   put the hourly sync in your crontab
```
